intro.value: A family-friendly campsite in Grímsnes, South Iceland, in the middle of the Golden Circle and about an hour from Reykjavík, with pitches for tents, caravans, campervans and motorhomes. It sits beside the Hraunborgir service centre, which has a swimming pool, hot tubs, sauna, restaurant (the Village Bar), TV lounge, playground and a small shop, and there is a golf course close by. Unusually for the Golden Circle it publishes year-round opening and actively advertises winter camping, and the operator says the service centre stays open through the winter. Þingvellir, Kerið, Geysir and Gullfoss are all within reach.

season.value: Open all year (tjalda.is: 'The campsite is open year-round'; own site: 'Open this winter'). In summer the service centre is open 09:00–21:00 on weekdays and until 23:00 at weekends (tjalda.is).
season.note: Winter service-centre opening hours are not published; the operator only says the service centre will remain open during winter.

winter.value: Open in winter. tjalda.is lists the campsite as open year-round, and the operator's own site says 'Open this winter' and that the campsite takes campervans, motorhomes, caravans and tents this winter, with hot tubs, showers and a TV lounge for campsite guests; site manager Sara (+354 832 3007) helps with access to the facilities. The operator's winter-rental page adds that the service centre stays open in winter, with food and drink, swimming and weekend events (bingo, pub quizzes). It is not on ferdalag.is's camper winter service list (checked 2026-11-10), which is an omission rather than a conflict. Winter opening hours, and whether the hook-ups and the waste disposal point work in frost, are not published: call ahead.

electricity.value: Yes – 'plenty of electrical hook-ups' (own camping page), 1,800 ISK per night (tjalda.is 2026), optional when booking. Number of hook-ups, amperage and winter availability: not published.

kitchen.note: No indoor guest kitchen is described by the operator or tjalda.is. The campsite has outdoor washing-up sinks, and the restaurant/Village Bar at the service centre serves food.

showers.value: Yes – campsite guests have access to showers throughout their stay, including in winter (operator); no separate fee mentioned.

toilets.value: Yes – outdoor toilets on the campsite (operator); tjalda.is also lists toilets, hot and cold water.

dump_station.value: Listed by tjalda.is ('Waste disposal for mobile homes'). The operator's own pages do not mention it, so its location, whether it takes cassette toilets and whether it is usable in winter are not published – ask the site manager.

wifi.value: Wi-Fi listed by tjalda.is (coverage not stated).

laundry.value: Washing machine and tumble dryer at the service centre (price not published).

camping_card.value: Not on the 2026 Útilegukortið (Camping Card) – Hraunborgir does not appear on the 2026 opening-dates list (checked 2026-11-10), so pay the normal rates.

practical.value: Book online on the operator's site (choose dates, adults/children and optional electricity; the total is shown before you pay). tjalda.is says the site also accepts drop-in guests.
In winter, call site manager Sara (+354 832 3007) before arriving – she helps campers get access to the hot tubs, showers and TV lounge.

Service centre: swimming pool (once named one of Iceland's 100 best pools), hot tubs, sauna, restaurant and Village Bar (homemade pizza, simple dishes), TV lounge, playground and playroom, basketball and football, and a shop selling everyday essentials, gas, sweets and ice cream. Swimwear and towels are available at reception.

The campsite was recently expanded and is sheltered, with walking trails and a viewpoint dial on the hill naming the surrounding landmarks; groups can hire 'Bryggjan', a covered area attached to the restaurant.
Pets on a leash, wheelchair access and EV charging are listed by tjalda.is.
Golf: Hraunborgir Golf Club (Ásgeirsvöllur) and Kiðjaberg Golf Club are both close by; a round at Hraunborgir costs 3,500 ISK and tee times are booked through GolfBox.
